name: Presidency of Kenya
notes: The President is head of state and government; not a chamber, so no seat chart.

name: National Assembly of Kenya
notes: 349 seats: 290 constituencies, 47 county women representatives and 12 nominated. Who sits and their party are from the Assembly's own table of members (parliament.go.ke); a few rows leave the party blank and show as 'Party not listed'. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Senate of Kenya
notes: 67 seats: 47 elected by county, 16 women, 2 youth and 2 persons with disabilities, nominated by the parties. Who sits and their party are from the Senate's own table of senators (parliament.go.ke). Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
